research_rationale: Dossier expressly lacks the target provision from EO:14096. The missing later lead cannot be resolved from this onefile; no current-law lead text is included despite machine hit counts. The NBAC expiry was extended from the original 1997 anniversary to 1999 by EO:13046 and to October 3, 2001 by EO:13137, which also replaced section 3, added a new section 4 and renumbered original sections 4–7 to 5–8. A commission expiry cannot terminate independent original sections 1–2. The first-end treatment of amended membership and commission-dependent commands requires separate scope judgments and adequate closure of extension leads; a blanket September 30, 2003 first end is unsupportable. Full original and actor contexts, own terms, earlier chain and all machine search scopes were read. EO:13316 section 3 expressly revokes this named order; section 6 confirms September 30, 2003 effectiveness, rather than its September 17 signing date. Its introductory reference to committees already terminated or whose work is complete does not identify an earlier termination date. Machine label Sec. 2 and partial-scope flags are segmentation metadata errors: the operative text is section 3, and this named item revokes the order in full. A source match is not a finding of the earliest ending. Provisional no status is preserved.

The eCFR/CFR search is point-in-time through 2026-10-14 across 49 titles. The USC search covers 58 title files only through 2026-10-09 and expressly omits the final five days of the legal cutoff. These searches are useful bounded EO/regulatory leads, but contain no report-submission evidence and do not search non-EO presidential extension instruments. Counts are not source text. No search IDs are selected while material closure remains unsupported.
